sermon.title: Imitate Me
sermon.speaker: Guest speaker (unnamed)
sermon.summary: A Father’s Day message on 1 Corinthians 4:15–16: many instructors, not many fathers. Paul, a spiritual father, said imitate me as I imitate Christ. Following Christ’s steps, fathers—natural and spiritual—are called to his example in baptism, the Spirit, answering temptation with Scripture, faithfulness to God’s house, zeal, surrender in Gethsemane and giving their lives in service.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Points to check: Jesus “is the Father… is the Holy Spirit… but they’re separate” (14:20) is loosely worded; fatherlessness statistics (1:30) unverified. Sensitive: a playground confrontation over his daughter (31:30); pastors making “tons of money.” Private first names (the speaker’s sisters, wife and daughter) appear only in the transcript.

chunks.section_question: Why do children imitate their parents?
chunks.short_answer: Children pick up their parents’ ways. 1 Corinthians 4:15: you may have ten thousand instructors in Christ, yet not many fathers. He cites fatherlessness statistics: fathers who love and discipline are badly needed. Proverbs: whom the Lord loves he corrects.

chunks.section_question: What is the final example for fathers?

faqs.question: Are true fathers rare?
faqs.answer: Yes—you have many instructors but not many fathers.

faqs.question: Can someone without children be a father?
Can women raise spiritual children?
faqs.answer: Yes—God sees neither male nor female.

faqs.question: Is baptism important?
faqs.answer: Yes—Jesus said it fulfills all righteousness.

faqs.question: Is the Old Testament still good?
faqs.answer: Yes—Jesus quoted it all the time.

faqs.question: What if reading the Bible makes you sleepy?
faqs.answer: Get up and walk around, read it aloud.

faqs.question: Why go to church?
faqs.answer: Jesus went as his custom; if you love Jesus you love his people.

faqs.question: Does the devil work through the flesh?
faqs.answer: He suggests and uses the flesh, especially when we’re down.
